rationale: With only 23 minutes to close and forced end-of-day liquidation looming, the position is trading well below the take-profit of $178.80 and the most recent candle shows a sharp drop to $177.72 on elevated volume (1.15M vs prior ~600-750K), suggesting selling pressure is building into the close. The 9-EMA at $177.61 is now above current price, momentum has stalled after failing to push through $178.38, and holding risks a market-close liquidation at an uncertain price with minimal remaining upside relative to the time cost. Closing now locks in a small gain and avoids the risk of a late-session flush back toward the invalidation level.
